messages.subject: =?UTF-8?Q?Apache_Airflow_Birthday_Party_in_Seoul_on_Oct_7_=F0=9F=8E=82?=
messages.body:
Hi everyone!
*We’re excited to invite you to the Apache Airflow Birthday Party in Seoul!
🎂🥳*

*Why October 7?*

October 7 marks the day of Airflow’s first official commit! The beginning
of what would eventually grow into the project and community we know today.

Fun fact: it wasn’t even called Airflow yet — the project was still named
*Flux*! 👀

In Korea, parents often give their baby a temporary nickname before birth,
called a *taemyeong* (태명), before the baby gets their actual name.

So, in a way, you could say *Flux was Airflow’s **taemyeong*. 😄

This year, the Apache Airflow Korea User Group is joining the celebration
from Korea to celebrate this special day together 🙌

This event will be a little different from our usual meetups.

Rather than focusing mainly on technical talks, we’ll look back at how
Airflow started and grew into the project and community it is today, share
the story of how the Airflow community in Korea came together, and hear
messages from people who have helped build Airflow along the way.

And most importantly, since it’s a birthday party, we’re also planning to
have some fun together! 🎉

*📅 Date:* Wednesday, October 7, 2026, 19:00–21:00 KST
*📍 Venue:* Snowflake, POSCO Tower Yeoksam, Seoul
*🎟 Registration:* September 18 ~
*Registration link:*
https://www.meetup.com/korea-apache-airflow-user-group/events/316548871

Whether you’ve been using Airflow for years, just started recently, or
simply want to learn more about Airflow and its community, everyone is
welcome.

A little more party than meetup,
a little more community than presentations.

Let’s celebrate Airflow’s journey so far and create the next chapter
together with the community.

See you at the party! 🎂🎉

*A big thank you to Snowflake for supporting our community by providing the
venue for this event! 🙌*

Best,
Yeonguk
-- 
추영욱 Yeonguk Choo

Mobile +82-10-8815-8118
Email  choo121600@ubuntu.com <choo121600@ubuntu-kr.org>

messages.body:
Hi everyone!

We celebrated Apache Airflow's birthday with the Korean Airflow community
last week! 🎉

This celebration was especially meaningful to us, as it was also an
opportunity to thank the people who have supported and helped our community
grow over the past three years.

A special shout-out to Kaxil, Shahar, Wei, Briana, Jens, and Jarek!
Each of you has played a part in helping our community grow, and it meant a
lot to us that you took the time to share your birthday wishes.

A huge thank you to Soo as well for supporting our community over the years
and helping make this event possible!

I've shared some photos and a recap of the event, along with a short
highlight video and the birthday messages we received.

* *Event recap(KO):*
https://discourse.airflow-kr.org/t/happy-birthday-airflow-3/635
* *Event highlight video:* https://youtu.be/W09MIylVSvc?si=Z1zst3iMM-CAbA_o
* *Birthday messages:* https://youtu.be/XO7EDK64VMA?si=Pe6mk7Qk-w5V8yPk

I also tried using AI to edit the video, and it turned out pretty well!
Haha 😄

A huge thank you to everyone who sent us birthday messages and helped make
this celebration special!

Best,
Yeonguk

> > > >
> > > > > Hi everyone!
> > > > > *We’re excited to invite you to the Apache Airflow Birthday Party in
> > > > > Seoul! 🎂🥳*

> > > > > *Why October 7?*
> > > > >
> > > > > October 7 marks the day of Airflow’s first official commit! The
> > > beginning
> > > > > of what would eventually grow into the project and community we know
> > > > today.
> > > > >
> > > > > Fun fact: it wasn’t even called Airflow yet — the project was still
> > > named
> > > > > *Flux*! 👀
> > > > >
> > > > > In Korea, parents often give their baby a temporary nickname before
> > > > birth,
> > > > > called a *taemyeong* (태명), before the baby gets their actual name.
> > > > >
> > > > > So, in a way, you could say *Flux was Airflow’s **taemyeong*. 😄

> > > > > This year, the Apache Airflow Korea User Group is joining the
> > > celebration
> > > > > from Korea to celebrate this special day together 🙌

> > hear
> > > > > messages from people who have helped build Airflow along the way.
> > > > >
> > > > > And most importantly, since it’s a birthday party, we’re also
> > planning
> > > to
> > > > > have some fun together! 🎉
